proposition: Nafsat II tells of a khirqa-yi tabarruk received from a prominent Sufi master before travelling abroad and of finding on return that the master's disciples had abandoned the Sharīʿa; his confrontation of the master went badly.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing from exile to Bāysunghur b. Shāhrukh
Melvin-Koushki, The Quest for a Universal Science (Yale 2012)
